invariants.name: theme_first_resolve_tracks_the_document
invariants.note: Resolving a document from nothing costs one pass over it, not more. The bound is the retained node count (controls plus their column), so a resolver that walked a parent chain per node would exceed it.

invariants.name: theme_first_resolve_publishes_each_node_once
invariants.note: One published resolved style per node at most. A node that inherits its parent's result verbatim shares that allocation instead.

notes: Issue #101 §4 control scale (1). First style pass over a fresh document.
